description: R6 step-1 + step-2 probe: extract Frobenius eigenvalues Frob_p(q) from the Habiro cyclotomic expansion of each atom's Markov trace by evaluating at u = ζ_{2p}. The cyclotomic Pochhammer (u; u)_m vanishes once m ≥ 2p, so the sum truncates after a finite number of terms. The Galois norm N(Frob_p) = Σ_{k coprime to 2p} Frob_p(ζ_{2p}^k) is verified to be a rational integer (residual < 1e-6) on every (atom, prime) where the truncation lands inside the on-disk Habiro data — finite-place reciprocity check.

summary.summary_note: step2_all_atoms_compatible is the NUMERATOR test: it asks only that Tr(numerator) be a rational integer, and the denominator does not enter. The full-trace test step2_all_atoms_full_trace_compatible is strictly stronger: it asks that the Galois trace of the DENOMINATOR-FOLDED value be a rational integer. CORRECTED 2026-08-28: an earlier wording said it 'requires the denominator to be a unit at ζ_{2p}, so Tr(Frob_p) is itself an algebraic integer'. That is wrong twice over — the denom_folded flag is a nonzero test performed over Q, not a unit test, and Frob_p is an algebraic integer on 0 of 45 cells, so a real unit test would pass nowhere. What the full-trace test detects is integrality of the TRACE, not of the element. Read the full-trace fields as the headline; the numerator fields pass on every cell and therefore discriminate nothing.
